basic_details.offering_entity: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: KAUST Campus (Thuwal, Makkah Province, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Biological and Environmental Science and Engineering (BESE), Computer, Electrical and Mathematical Science and Engineering (CEMSE), Physical Science and Engineering (PSE).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of admitted graduate students receive the full KAUST Fellowship (~250 to 300 new admits/year)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally based on talent; Pakistan has a large and distinguished cohort of scholars across all academic divisions
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: MS: typically 1.5 to 2 years; PhD: 3.5 to 4 years

nationality_requirements: Open to international students of all nationalities (including Pakistan)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of education (Bachelor's degree) for MS; 18 years (Master's degree) for PhD from an accredited institution in a relevant STEM field.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.70 / 4.00 CGPA; admitted international students typically present 3.80+ / 4.00 CGPA or rank in top 5% of graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate foundation in mathematics, computing, engineering, or natural sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior laboratory research experience, high-impact publications, or international hackathon/coding achievements heavily prioritized.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT minimum 79 (KAUST Code: 4107) or IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (overall score). Official score report is mandatory.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic not required; English is the official language of instruction and campus life.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; mixed-gender international research community.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite research potential; every admitted student automatically receives the fellowship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition support and all academic laboratory fees covered for the full duration of the degree.

admission_application_fee.details: Online application to KAUST is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free private on-campus housing (private air-conditioned apartment or shared villa with private ensuite bathroom) on the Red Sea campus.

monthly_stipend.details: High-tier annual living allowance paid monthly: $20,000 to $30,000 per year ($1,666 to $2,500/month ~PKR 465,000 to 700,000/month depending on degree level and progression).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip international airfare provided between home city in Pakistan and Jeddah.

visa_fee.details: Saudi student visa and Iqama (residence permit) fees fully sponsored and processed by KAUST.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage provided at the on-campus KAUST Health Center and private hospitals in Saudi Arabia.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: State-of-the-art laptop, compute clusters (Shaheen supercomputer), and lab supplies provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full travel, registration, and lodging support for accepted international conference presentations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (World-renowned research institute).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked #1 globally in QS Citations per Faculty; world leader in clean combustion, AI, desalination, and solar energy.
available_majors: Computer Science, Applied Mathematics and Computational Science (AMCS), Statistics, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Material Science and Engineering, Applied Physics, Bioengineering, Bioscience, Marine Science, Environmental Science and Engineering, Energy Resources and Petroleum Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: MS: 3 to 4 semesters (36 credits); PhD: 3.5 to 4 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: All admitted students are automatically awarded the KAUST Fellowship; admission is 100% funded.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: CS, AI, and Electrical Engineering are highly competitive; contacting prospective faculty whose research interests match yours is encouraged.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight technical problem-solving, coding competitions, research publications, and clear alignment with KAUST core research centers.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the KAUST admissions portal, complete personal background, upload SOP, transcripts, CV, and designate three referees.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Create account on KAUST graduate portal (Opens September for Fall intake).
2. Upload Statement of Purpose, academic transcripts, and detailed CV.
3. Provide three academic recommendation letter contacts.
4. Submit official TOEFL or IELTS scores (KAUST Code: 4107).
5. Complete online application before deadline (Early round: January; Regular round: March).
6. Academic divisions conduct technical screening interviews via video conference.
7. Shortlisted candidates invited for KAUST Admissions Interview (video or in-person).
8. Admission and full fellowship package offer issued.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct single application; all admits receive the fellowship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure electronic link sent by KAUST.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose (750 words): Detail your academic background, research interests, career goals, and reasons for choosing KAUST.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants should describe prior research contributions and proposed research questions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV highlighting publications, GitHub repositories, lab techniques, and honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Two rounds: 30-minute academic faculty interview testing technical competence, followed by a personal interview assessing motivation and character.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE is NOT required (though general scores are considered if submitted); TOEFL or IELTS mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official university transcripts certified by Pakistani degree-granting institution; HEC attestation required for visa.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 750-word essay explaining academic motivation, research interests, and career goals
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly articulated technical vision aligned with KAUST research groups

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential reports from research supervisors or professors
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From professors who supervised your research or senior project in Pakistan

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for all undergraduate and graduate education with grading scheme
Official TOEFL iBT (79+) or IELTS Academic (6.5+) report
Comprehensive academic CV detailing publications, awards, and technical skills
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlighting FYP, publications, and competitive programming achievements

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Early round deadline is mid-January; regular deadline is early March. Admissions operate on rolling evaluation.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Academic GPA, transcripts, foundational excellence in math and physical sciences)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Research publications, conference presentations, technical projects, and lab skills)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Statement of Purpose alignment with faculty labs)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Completely need-blind; all admitted students are fully funded)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Division Faculty Admissions Committees and the KAUST Central Graduate Admissions Panel.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous holistic review identifying individuals with exceptional scientific curiosity, research talent, and potential to make breakthrough discoveries.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~10,000 to 12,000 applications globally across all divisions
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with top-tier grades, research publications, and exceptional performance in technical video interviews.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of top Pakistani universities (LUMS, NUST, GIKI, FAST-NUCES, Quaid-i-Azam, UET).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Egypt, USA, India, Italy, Mexico.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam agencies claiming to guarantee KAUST admission for a fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: KAUST application is 100% free of charge. Never pay any fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through agents; KAUST directly interviews every admitted student.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC and MOFA attestation fees in Pakistan.
Passport issuance and NADRA document verification fees.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You need to pay for housing or tuition. (Fact: 100% of tuition, luxury campus housing, healthcare, flights, and living stipends are provided free).
MYTH: You cannot bring family. (Fact: Married MS/PhD students are provided spacious 2-bedroom or 3-bedroom family housing and family healthcare).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: External blogs state the stipend is $10,000; the official fellowship provides $20,000 to $30,000 per year.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.00; falling below results in academic probation and potential termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence on the KAUST campus in Thuwal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews and doctoral dissertation committee milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Outside employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars can pursue global careers or continue in Saudi Arabia under Saudi Vision 2030 talent visas.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of fellowship occurs upon academic failure or voluntary withdrawal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is provided for normal program length (max 2 years for MS; max 4 years for PhD).
